save_torch_model: save a PyTorch model to disk with sharding, safe serialization, and shared tensor handling
save_torch_state_dict: save a PyTorch state dictionary to disk with configurable sharding and serialization format
split_torch_state_dict_into_shards: split a PyTorch state dictionary into shards smaller than a given max size
load_torch_model: load a sharded or single checkpoint file into a PyTorch model
load_state_dict_from_file: load a PyTorch checkpoint from a safetensors or pickle file with optional memory mapping
